bio.topic: Review: coordination, homeostasis, drugs and reproduction

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which part of a neurone carries impulses away from the cell body?
questions.hint: Think of the long fibre leading towards the next neurone.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the gap between two neurones.
questions.hint: Neurotransmitters diffuse across it.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What is the correct order of a reflex arc?
options: receptor → sensory neurone → relay neurone → motor neurone → effector
effector → motor neurone → relay neurone → sensory neurone → receptor
receptor → motor neurone → relay neurone → sensory neurone → effector
sensory neurone → receptor → effector → motor neurone → relay neurone
questions.answer: receptor → sensory neurone → relay neurone → motor neurone → effector
questions.hint: Start where the stimulus is detected.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which gland secretes insulin?
questions.hint: It also produces digestive enzymes.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Compared with nervous control, hormonal control is usually…
questions.hint: Hormones travel in the blood.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the hormone released by the adrenal glands in a 'fight or flight' situation.
questions.hint: It increases heart rate.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: When blood glucose concentration falls, the pancreas releases glucagon. What does glucagon cause the liver to do?
questions.hint: The aim is to raise blood glucose.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which of these happens in the skin when body temperature rises above normal?
options: vasodilation of arterioles near the surface
questions.answer: vasodilation of arterioles near the surface
questions.hint: More blood near the surface loses more heat.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What term describes the maintenance of a constant internal environment?
questions.hint: It includes control of temperature and blood glucose.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Negative feedback means that a change from the set point…
options: triggers a response that reverses the change
triggers a response that increases the change
has no effect on the body
questions.answer: triggers a response that reverses the change
questions.hint: Think of a thermostat.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which type of drug is penicillin?
questions.hint: It kills bacteria but not viruses.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Explain why antibiotics should not be used to treat viral infections such as the common cold.
questions.hint: Consider what antibiotics target and the risk of resistance.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Where does fertilisation normally take place in humans?
questions.hint: It is also called the Fallopian tube.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which hormone, produced mainly by the ovaries, causes the lining of the uterus to thicken after menstruation?
questions.hint: It is also responsible for female secondary sexual characteristics.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: In a 28-day menstrual cycle, menstruation lasts from day 1 to day 5 and ovulation happens on day 14. How many days after the last day of menstruation does ovulation occur?
questions.hint: Subtract the last day of bleeding from the ovulation day.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Describe two roles of the placenta in supporting a developing fetus.
questions.hint: Think about substances that pass in each direction.

bss.topic: Revisão do 1º term: Brasil colonial, cartografia e geologia

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual era o principal produto de exportação do Brasil colonial nos séculos XVI e XVII?
questions.hint: Pense nos engenhos do Nordeste.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual árvore deu nome ao Brasil e foi o primeiro produto explorado pelos portugueses?
questions.hint: Dela se extraía uma tinta vermelha.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual sistema administrativo dividiu o território em grandes faixas de terra entregues a donatários, a partir de 1534?
questions.hint: Eram passadas de pai para filho.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual cidade foi a primeira capital do Brasil colonial?
questions.hint: Fica na Bahia.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: No século XVIII, a descoberta de ouro deslocou o centro econômico da colônia para qual região?
questions.hint: O nome da região já dá a pista.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que era o 'pacto colonial'?
options: a obrigação de a colônia comerciar apenas com a metrópole
um acordo de paz com povos indígenas
a divisão do território entre Portugal e Espanha
a lei que aboliu a escravidão
questions.answer: a obrigação de a colônia comerciar apenas com a metrópole
questions.hint: Pense em quem controlava o comércio.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique por que os quilombos são considerados uma forma de resistência à escravidão no Brasil colonial.
questions.hint: Pense em quem vivia neles e no que significavam.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em um mapa na escala 1:100.000, quanto representa 1 cm?
questions.hint: 100.000 cm = ? metros.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em um mapa de escala 1:250.000, duas cidades estão a 8 cm uma da outra. Qual é a distância real, em quilômetros?
questions.hint: Multiplique e converta centímetros para quilômetros.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual mapa tem MAIOR escala (mostra mais detalhes)?
questions.hint: Quanto menor o denominador, maior a escala.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: As linhas imaginárias que medem a distância em graus a partir da Linha do Equador são os…
questions.hint: Elas correm de leste a oeste.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama a representação do relevo por linhas que ligam pontos de mesma altitude?
questions.hint: Aparecem em mapas topográficos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é a forma de relevo predominante no território brasileiro?
options: depressões abaixo do nível do mar
questions.hint: O Brasil não tem cordilheiras como os Andes.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que o Brasil praticamente não tem vulcões ativos nem grandes terremotos?
options: porque está no centro da placa Sul-Americana
questions.answer: porque está no centro da placa Sul-Americana
questions.hint: Pense em onde ficam os limites das placas tectônicas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual tipo de rocha se forma pelo acúmulo e compactação de sedimentos?
questions.hint: O nome vem de 'sedimento'.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique a diferença entre agentes internos e agentes externos na formação do relevo, dando um exemplo de cada.
questions.hint: Uns vêm do interior da Terra; outros atuam na superfície.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which method of production makes one unique product at a time, such as a wedding dress?
questions.hint: Each order is a separate 'job'.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is an advantage of flow production?
options: work is very varied for employees
questions.hint: Think of economies of scale.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What term describes a production approach where materials arrive exactly when they are needed, so little stock is held?
questions.hint: Its initials are three letters.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Quality assurance differs from quality control because it…
options: checks quality at every stage of production
removes the need for any standards
questions.answer: checks quality at every stage of production
questions.hint: Think about prevention rather than detection.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which of these is a fixed cost for a café?
questions.hint: It does not change with the number of drinks sold.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business has fixed costs of $12,000. Each unit sells for $20 and has a variable cost of $8. Calculate the break-even output in units.
questions.hint: Divide fixed costs by contribution per unit.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Using the same business (price $20, variable cost $8, fixed costs $12,000), calculate the profit if 1,500 units are sold, in dollars.
questions.hint: Total revenue minus total costs.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What is the margin of safety?
options: the amount by which sales exceed the break-even level
the cash held in the bank
questions.answer: the amount by which sales exceed the break-even level
questions.hint: Compare actual output with break-even output.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business starts the month with an opening cash balance of $3,000. Cash inflows are $7,500 and cash outflows are $9,200. Calculate the closing cash balance in dollars.
questions.hint: Opening balance + inflows − outflows.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is a way to improve cash flow in the short term?
options: ask customers to pay more quickly
questions.answer: ask customers to pay more quickly
questions.hint: Get money in sooner or pay it out later.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which financial statement shows revenue, costs and profit over a period of time?
questions.hint: It used to be called the profit and loss account.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Revenue is $50,000 and cost of sales is $30,000. Calculate the gross profit in dollars.
questions.hint: Gross profit = revenue − cost of sales.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Gross profit is $20,000 and revenue is $50,000. Calculate the gross profit margin as a percentage.
questions.hint: (Gross profit ÷ revenue) × 100.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A statement of financial position shows a business's…
options: assets and liabilities at one point in time
questions.answer: assets and liabilities at one point in time
questions.hint: It is like a snapshot.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Explain why a profitable business might still run out of cash.
questions.hint: Consider the timing of payments from customers and to suppliers.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A bakery is considering replacing batch production with flow production. Discuss one advantage and one disadvantage of this change.
questions.hint: Think about costs, flexibility and product variety.

chem.topic: Review: metals, chemistry of the environment, fuels, alkanes and alkenes

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which metal is extracted from its ore by electrolysis rather than by reduction with carbon?
questions.hint: It is more reactive than carbon.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Name the main iron ore used in the blast furnace.
questions.hint: Its formula is Fe₂O₃.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: In the blast furnace, which substance acts as the main reducing agent for iron(III) oxide?
questions.hint: It is formed from coke and carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: What is the purpose of adding limestone to the blast furnace?
options: to remove silicon dioxide impurities as slag
questions.answer: to remove silicon dioxide impurities as slag
questions.hint: Calcium oxide reacts with acidic impurities.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Why is aluminium resistant to corrosion even though it is a reactive metal?
options: it has a protective oxide layer
it is below hydrogen in the reactivity series
it does not react with oxygen
it is always alloyed with gold
questions.answer: it has a protective oxide layer
questions.hint: Think about what forms on its surface.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which pollutant is produced by incomplete combustion of fuels and is toxic because it reduces the blood's ability to carry oxygen?
questions.hint: It binds to haemoglobin.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which gas is the main cause of acid rain from burning fossil fuels containing sulfur?
questions.hint: Its name tells you which element it contains.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: What does a catalytic converter change carbon monoxide into?
questions.hint: It adds oxygen to the CO.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Fractional distillation separates crude oil because the fractions have different…
questions.hint: The column is hotter at the bottom.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: What is the general formula of the alkanes?
questions.hint: Ethane has 2 carbon atoms and 6 hydrogen atoms.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: How many hydrogen atoms are in one molecule of propane?
questions.hint: Use the alkane general formula with n = 3.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Which reagent can distinguish an alkene from an alkane?
questions.hint: One of them decolourises it.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Alkanes react with chlorine in the presence of ultraviolet light. What type of reaction is this?
questions.hint: A hydrogen atom is swapped for a chlorine atom.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Name the product formed when ethene reacts with steam in the presence of a catalyst.
questions.hint: It is an alcohol with two carbon atoms.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Why are alkenes described as unsaturated?
options: they contain a C=C double bond
questions.answer: they contain a C=C double bond
questions.hint: Think about what allows addition reactions.

questions.subject: chem
questions.q: Explain why cracking is used in the petrochemical industry.
questions.hint: Compare the supply of long-chain fractions with the demand for shorter ones.
